info.name: SupportDesk Pro API
info.description:
Full Postman collection for the SupportDesk Pro REST API.

**Setup:**
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to `http://localhost:4000`
2. Call **POST /auth/register** or **POST /auth/login** — the test script will auto-set `accessToken` and `orgId`.
3. All authenticated requests will automatically use the stored token.

**Variables used:**
- `baseUrl` — API base (default: http://localhost:4000)
- `accessToken` — set automatically after login/register
- `orgId` — set automatically after login/register
- `ticketId`, `teamId`, `userId`, `commentId`, `policyId`, `webhookId`, `articleId`, `categoryId`, `responseId`, `invitationId`, `attachmentId`, `surveyId` — set these manually after creating resources

request.description: Returns `{ ok: true }` when the server is running.

Creates a new organisation and admin user. Rate-limited. Sets `accessToken` and `orgId` automatically.

**Body:**
- `email` (required)
- `password` min 8 chars (required)
- `name` (required)
- `orgName` (optional — defaults to user's name)
Authenticates a user. Returns access token in body and sets refresh token as an httpOnly cookie. Sets `accessToken` and `orgId` automatically.

Issues a new access token using the `refresh_token` httpOnly cookie. Postman must have cookie handling enabled.

Updates `accessToken` automatically.
Revokes the access token (adds jti to Redis blocklist) and clears the refresh cookie.

Accepts an org invitation. `token` comes from the invitation email link.

**Body:**
- `token` (required)
- `name` (required)
- `password` min 8 chars (required)
Returns the currently authenticated user's profile.

All body fields are optional.

Returns the current user's profile within the org.

Updates the current user's profile.

**Body:**
- `name` 1–100 chars (optional)
Lists all org users. **Requires ADMIN or TEAM_LEAD role.**
Returns a specific user's profile.
Deactivates a user. **Requires ADMIN role.**

**Body:**

request.description:
Lists tickets with optional filters. Customers only see their own tickets.

**Query params (all optional):**
- `status`, `priority`, `assigneeId`, `teamId`, `channel`
- `cursor` + `limit` for pagination

Creates a ticket. Automatically sets SLA deadline, enqueues acknowledgement email, SLA check, and webhook events.

**Body:**
- `subject` 1–255 chars (required)
- `description` min 1 (required)
- `priority` LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | URGENT (optional, default MEDIUM)
- `channel` WEB | EMAIL | API (optional, default WEB)
- `customFields` object (optional)
Returns a full ticket with assignee, team, and SLA info. Customers can only fetch their own tickets.

Updates ticket fields. **Requires min AGENT role.**

**Body (all optional):**
- `subject`, `description`, `priority`, `customFields`

Transitions ticket status through the state machine.

**Allowed statuses:** `NEW | OPEN | PENDING | ON_HOLD | SOLVED | CLOSED`

Closing a ticket triggers a delayed CSAT survey email.

Assigns ticket to an agent and/or team. **Requires min AGENT role.**

**Body (all optional, nullable to unassign):**
- `assigneeId` UUID or null
- `teamId` UUID or null
Soft-deletes a ticket. **Requires ADMIN role.**
Lists all comments on a ticket. Internal comments are hidden from customers.

Adds a comment/reply to a ticket.

**Body:**
- `body` min 1 char (required)
- `isInternal` boolean (optional, default false — set to true for agent-only notes)
Edits a comment. Users can only edit their own comments; agents/leads have broader edit rights.
Deletes a comment.
Lists all attachments for a ticket.

**Body:**

- `mimeType` (required)
- `sizeBytes` number > 0 (required)
